note: Robe reel (Shkolnik et al., Nature 1980). Sets: park (l01-l03, l07-l09), lab (l04-l05), cutaway (l06).

lines.see: Under a blazing sun in the park, Wren in all white and Bram in all black stand side by side; heat shimmers off the path and a WHITE vs BLACK split pops between them.
Wren and Bram side by side; sun rays bounce off Wren's white shirt (BOUNCES) but sink into Bram's black one with an orange hot spot (SOAKS UP).
Close on Bram, heat lines rising off his black shirt and a +6 C stamp slamming in beside him.
In a lab a 1980 stamp slams in, a thermometer pops up beside Wren and Bram, and heat arrows flow down into each body.
Both thermometers read exactly the same level and a big SAME stamp slams in between Wren and Bram.
Cutaway: a black robe cylinder swings open to show the body inside with a wide air gap round it, labelled LOOSE: AIR GAP.
Back in the sun, heat shimmers off Bram's black shirt; a HOT AIR arrow starts inside his chest and rises up out of his neck.
Big blue COOL AIR IN arrows curl in from below at his feet and up under his shirt; Bram smiles in the breeze.
A TIGHT callout rings Bram's shirt, a NO BREEZE stamp slams in, the thermometer shoots to 400 and Bram cooks in heat lines.
